remarks: Wonderful top floor condo is exceptionally appointed with high end finishing and is move in ready. Amazing transformation to a luxury, elegant residence with 2 bedrooms in New Canaan's most prime sought after location. This condo is unique with a separate home office accessed by French doors. The granite kitchen is bright and modern and the upgraded bath is light and white. Experience this luxurious residence with custom moldings and radiator covers, recessed lighting, generous closets plus additional storage. Gas heat and hot water are included in the low monthly common charges. This condo has a gorgeous view of a treelined landscape and is located in the quiet rear corner of the complex with easy back door access. Loads of storage including lower level area storage. Reserved parking and private patio are right outside the door. Whether you are a first time purchaser or looking for a relaxed life style or even an investment opportunity, this perfectly located condo checks all the boxes. Situated across from dog friendly Mead Park with gorgeous pond for skating and fishing, baseball fields, tennis and pickleball courts, playground and outdoor cafe, the location is perfect. Also just steps away from New Canaan's vibrant town center with it's award winning restaurants, movie theater, shops, brand new library, galleries and train to NYC. For in town living, this is a dream come true.
